name: socai-social-research
description: Research public posts, comments, creators, and trends on Xiaohongshu, Douyin, TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, and X/Twitter with the local socai CLI and the user's authenticated Chrome session.

interface.longDescription: Research public posts, comments, creators, and trends on Xiaohongshu (XHS/RedNote/Redbook), Douyin, TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, and X (Twitter) through the locally installed Socai CLI and the user's authenticated Chrome session. Socai social-platform research is read-only and returns source-linked evidence.
defaultPrompt: Research Xiaohongshu comments about Adidas running shoes and cite every source.
Compare TikTok and Instagram reactions to this product with source links.
Compare LinkedIn and X/Twitter discussion about this company announcement.
